description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientIdentifierWritePlatformService interface using JPA repositories. It provides methods for adding, updating, and deleting client identifiers within the Fineract framework, handling data integrity issues, and ensuring proper security context execution.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of client identifier write operations including add, update, and delete, with handling for data integrity and exceptions.

methods.name: addClientIdentifier
methods.description: Creates and saves a new client identifier for a given client, handling data integrity violations.

methods.name: updateClientIdentifier
methods.description: Updates an existing client identifier with new data, checking for modifications and integrity.

methods.name: deleteClientIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes a specified client identifier associated with a client.

methods.name: handleClientIdentifierDataIntegrityViolation
methods.description: Handles exceptions related to data integrity violations during database operations.

methods.name: logAsErrorUnexpectedDataIntegrityException
methods.description: Logs unexpected data integrity exceptions at error level.
